scenarios.title: DEXPI C01 reference P&ID, described in words
scenarios.prompt: Can you draw up the P&ID for our utilities section (drawing 123/A93)? It goes like this. Feed comes in from off the sheet on line 47121 to centrifugal pump P-4711, which pushes it on line 47122 through plate heat exchanger H-1007 (the other side of H-1007 is a utility, in on line 47130 and out on 47131). From H-1007, line 47123 runs through an actuated on/off globe valve HV-4750.01 into tank T-4750; HV-4750.01 is opened and shut by hand switch HS-4750.01 in the control room. From the bottom of T-4750, line 47124 goes through a butterfly valve, a swing check valve, a reducer and a ball valve to the reciprocating pump P-4712. P-4712 discharges into header 47126: first a tee to a drain ball valve, then a tee to safety valve SV-104.01 (set at 6 barg), which relieves on line 47125 back into T-4750; then a ball-valved tapping for local pressure gauge PI-4712.01; then a ball valve in the header; then a branch into the tube side of floating-head exchanger H-1008; then a second ball-valved tapping for pressure controller PICSA-4712.02 in the DCS; and finally the header leaves the sheet as product. Out of H-1008 the stream goes back to T-4750 on line 47127 through control valve PV-4712.02, which PICSA-4712.02 throttles to hold the discharge pressure. H-1008's other side takes a utility in on line 47140 and out on 47141 through control valve TV-4750.03, worked by TICSA-4750.03, which measures the temperature in T-4750.
